edit.old: - First mention (3): 《Y》将由黑白版面改为… then Y的标准 → `改为-01 :ARG1 (b / 版面 :part-of (n / newspaper :name ... :ARG1-of (identity-91 ...)) :mod (h / 黑白))` … `(标准 :possessor n)`.
- V1V2的N (3): 已经停止发行的小报 → `(x / 小报 :ARG1-of (f / 发行-01 :ARG1-of (t / 停止-01 :mod (y / 已经) :aspect state) :aspect habitual))`.
- Procedure compound (3): 一般的新闻查证程序 → `(x / 程序 :ARG0-of (i / identity-91 :ARG1 (c / 查证-01 :ARG1 (n / 新闻) :aspect process)) :mod (y / 一般))`.
- 有关系 (3): 与P'Lod有暧昧关系，后来还领养 → `(c / consecutive :op1 (y / 有-03 :ARG0 (a / and :op1 h :op2 p) :ARG1 关系) :op2 领养-01)`.
- Part and relative clause (3): 创立黑白版面的《Y》，容纳…文章 → `:ARG1 (b / 版面 :mod (h / 黑白) :part-of (n / newspaper ...) :ARG0-of (r / 容纳-01 :ARG1 ... :aspect process))`.

- 虽然…不过 (2.5): 虽然他们宣称X（标语：Y），不过大部分报导以博君一笑为目的 → `(b / but-91 :ARG1 (a / and :op1 宣称 :op2 (i / identity-91 :ARG1 标语 :ARG2 Y)) :ARG2 (i2 / identity-91 :ARG1 (m / 目的 :purpose-of 报导) :ARG2 (g / 博君一笑)))`; that 报导 also gets `(newspaper :full-affirmative 报导)`.

- Temporal (5.1): 创刊于1979年 → `(document-creation-time :before s6d)` `(s6d :overlap s6x)`; purpose 为运用 → `(创立 :overlap 运用)`; reason 因为…改为 → `(创立 :before 改为)`; 遗留下来的印刷机 used by 运用 → `(运用 :before 遗留)`; 也成了…特色 → `(prev-main :overlap 成)`.
- 以…而闻名 (2.5): a tabloid known for its reports → `(x / 小报 :ARG1-of (k / 闻名-01 :reason (r / 报导-01 :ARG0 x)))`.
- Shared modifier (3): 奇怪的新闻与专栏 → `(a / and :op1 (n / 新闻 :mod (q / 奇怪)) :op2 (z / 专栏 :mod q))`.
- Every named person in a Chinese document is `individual-person`. Plain concepts with no sense (真实, 博君一笑, 中) get no temporal or modal triple.
- Coreference across sentences is in `:coref`; within a sentence it is a re-entrancy.

edit.anchor: the copula (*be*, 是) — it becomes one of the abstract predicates.
edit.text: A Chinese adjective that has a roleset (真实, 显著) is an event even before a noun: `N :ARG0-of (真实-01 :aspect state)`, with `(head-event :overlap X)` and an author triple. X者 → `者 :ARG0-of (X-00 :aspect state)`; 复制人 → `人 :ARG1-of (复制-01 :aspect process)`.

A headline in 「 」 counted as an article (一篇「…」) or in apposition to 新闻/报导 is `publication :name`: every word and each mark (「, 」, ！) is an `:opN`; 一篇 → `:quant 1 :unit 篇`. Nothing inside it gets a node, `:quote`, temporal or modal triple. 「…」 right after a reporting verb, with no classifier, stays ...

edit.old: Except: no node for 仍/还 before 继续/保持/依然, nor for 都 in 都以…为目的.
edit.new: Except: no node for 甚至, for 仍/还 before 继续/保持/依然, for 都 in 都以…为目的, or for 还/也 that only adds a further conjunct or clause (还注销了, 但其编辑也有); keep 也 on a stand-alone sentence's main verb (他们也报导了).

edit.anchor: - X 与/和/跟 Y 有关系 → `有-03 :ARG0 (and :op1 X :op2 Y)`, not `:companion`.
edit.text: - 靠 X (而) V → `V :reason X`, no 靠 node. 有能力 + VP → `有-06 :ARG1 (能力 :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 VP :aspect state))`, identity-91 with an author triple. A publication's 内容/新闻/文章 → `:part-of` it. 外交政策 → `政策 :topic 外交`; 握手的照片 → `照片 :mod 握手-01`. X的墙上 (a group located there) → `墙上 :place-of X`.

edit.anchor: In `(and :op1 A :op2 B)`, B's parent is A: `(A :overlap B)`, never document-creation-time.
edit.text: With three or more conjuncts, chain them: `(op1 :overlap op2)` `(op2 :overlap op3)`. A reported past event takes the reporting verb as parent (`(指 :before 当选)`), even if it has its own date (which then gets no triple).

why: the instruction would have 30079 characters (at most 30000)

edit.anchor: an event nested inside a claimed -91 state gets only the author triple.
edit.text: - The reporting entity (paper, person) is the conceiver of its own reporting acts (报导, 指, 刊登, 注销): `(author :full-affirmative paper)` `(paper :full-affirmative 报导)`, not author → 报导. An event that is an argument of a content event (当 under 支持) gets no modal triple and no aspect. Never give a modal ...

edit.old: No `:subset-of` without a clearly stated set.
edit.new: No `:subset-of` without a clearly stated set. Never corefer generic kind nouns (外星人 in two different reports).
